scholarships.title: Boston College Gabelli Presidential Scholars Program

existing.description: The Gabelli Presidential Scholars Program is Boston College's premier undergraduate academic merit programme. Each year it awards full-tuition scholarships together with fully-funded, programme-sponsored summer programmes to 18 incoming freshmen. Scholars enrol in a University departmental honours programme and take part in summer experiences in service learning, international study and professional internships. There is no separate application: Early Decision and Regular Decision candidates who file their BC application by the November 1 priority scholarship deadline are considered.
eligibility: Applying for fall admission to Boston College
Submitting an Early Decision or Regular Decision application by the November 1 priority scholarship deadline
Academic excellence, demonstrated leadership ability and significant community service (programme history)
